meta.name: Playful Soft-UI Mobile Design System
meta.purpose: Context for AI code generation. Replicate the visual language, not the specific content of the source screenshots.

style.summary: Friendly, playful, consumer-fintech/lifestyle mobile UI. Soft pastel gradients, oversized rounded corners, white floating cards on a pale lavender-grey canvas, bold black display type, 3D/emoji-style characters and mascots as hero art, and high-contrast pill CTAs.
style.density: medium-low; generous whitespace inside cards, tight grouping between related rows
style.depth_model: flat surfaces with very soft, diffuse shadows; depth comes from card layering and gradient hero areas, never harsh borders
style.shape_language: squircles and pills everywhere; no sharp corners
illustration_style: 3D-rendered or claymation-like avatars/characters with glossy pastel materials
Flat blobby mascots with simple dot eyes and smile, thick black or saturated yellow/pink/blue fills
Sticker-like decorative sparkles (4-point stars) in pastel colors scattered near hero elements
Oversized bold lettering used as a graphic banner behind characters (partially cropped)
style.overall_composition: Cards in a vertical feed. Each screen = optional gradient hero/header + one or more white rounded cards + one dominant CTA.

color.approach: Neutral white/near-white surfaces + black text + one or two saturated accent hues per screen + pastel gradients for heroes and highlights.

purple.use: charts, banners, icons, highlights, active states

orange.use: primary action buttons, toggles ON, selected radio/check

pink.use: gradient CTAs, card art, hero accents

blue.use: sky gradients, info icons, stat chips

green.use: success status, online dots, positive deltas

rules: Keep >=90% of UI area neutral (white/off-white); accents are for focal points only.
Pick ONE dominant hero hue per screen and echo it in small accents (icons, chart line, chips).
Tinted backgrounds for chips/icons use the accent's 'tint' with the accent's 'base' as icon/text color.
Gradients are always soft and low-contrast except on CTAs and rare highlight numbers.

font_family.display: 'Plus Jakarta Sans' or a heavy rounded geometric grotesk (weight 800), tight tracking
font_family.mono_numeric: tabular-nums on primary font for prices and balances

display_xl.use: hero headlines, section titles on hero art (e.g. big 'Collection', 'Share the vibe')

display_amount.use: big currency/amount display, may use gradient text

micro.use: sub-labels under list rows, helper text

rules: Headlines are bold/black and left- or center-aligned depending on hero context; center-align for celebratory or empty-state modals.
Secondary text is a mid-grey, 1 to 2 steps smaller than primary.
Prices/amounts right-aligned in lists; title + tiny subtitle stacked on the left.
Use sentence case, short phrases. Avoid all-caps except tiny section labels.

elevation.rules: Shadows are large-blur, very low opacity, slightly purple-tinted. Prefer shadow over borders. Inner cells within a card use a subtle fill (#F6F6FA) instead of a shadow.

borders.note: Most separation comes from fill contrast and whitespace, not outlines.

iconography.style: rounded, friendly, filled or duotone; 20 to 24px glyphs; consistent 1.75 to 2px stroke if outline

app_icon_tile.fill: saturated pastel (purple, green, lime, pink, orange, yellow)

avatars.style: emoji/memoji or 3D character busts on pastel circular backgrounds
avatars.stacked_group: overlapping circles with -8px margin and 2px white ring

hero_art: Large character illustrations that overlap or break out of the card boundary
Cropped giant display lettering as decorative backdrop
Cloud shapes, sparkles, floating stickers around a central avatar
Stack of rotated, overlapping illustrated cards (carousel peek) with pastel gradients
imagery.decoration: 4-point sparkles, small hearts, music notes, swirls in 12 to 24px, placed asymmetrically, low opacity or pastel

layout.grid: single-column feed; occasional 2-col stat grid (gap 12) and 4-col icon grid
layout.alignment: content left-aligned in cards; modals/celebratory states centered
screen_anatomy: Optional status/top area with small circular utility buttons (close, back, more) at 28 to 32px, grey fill
Hero zone: gradient or illustration, 160 to 260px tall, bleeds to screen edges with rounded bottom/top corners
Content zone: stacked white cards overlapping the hero by 16 to 24px
Primary CTA: full-width pill, 52 to 56px tall, near bottom of card/sheet

modal_sheet.presentation: rounded-top sheet or phone-frame card with 32px radius, small grab handle or circular close button top-right
modal_sheet.close_button: 28px circle, light grey fill, x glyph

layout.safe_areas: respect device notch/home indicator; bottom padding >= 24px

variants.tinted: pastel gradient background with white inner cells at 70% opacity

inner_cell.use: stat tiles, list rows inside a larger white card

segmented_control.variant_tabs_pills: row of pills; active = black fill + white text, inactive = light grey fill + grey text

list_row.structure: [leading icon/logo 40px] [title body_strong + subtitle micro stacked] [trailing value / ring / toggle / button]
list_row.container: inner_cell or plain row with 1px divider
list_row.trailing_value: body_strong, right-aligned; secondary line (cycle/frequency) in micro grey; due-soon date in red

stat_tile.layout: 2-column grid; each tile: icon chip + label (caption) on top row, value (body_strong/h3) below

day_selector.layout: horizontal row of 5 days, each: weekday micro label, date number, mood/emoji status below
day_selector.active: pill with accent fill (#C7F0A8 or brand tint), bolder text

balance_card.layout: title/amount row + 4-up circular action/category shortcuts with micro badge counts
balance_card.badge: 14px circle, red/orange bg, white 9px bold number, top-right of icon

radio_card_option.selected: check circle filled orange (22px) + hairline orange border or tinted bg
radio_card_option.price: right-aligned, strikethrough or secondary for unit price

components.feature_row_with_toggle: icon chip (28px tint) + title body_strong + subtitle micro + trailing toggle

chart_card.type: smooth line (monotone cubic) with 2.5px stroke, accent purple #8B5CF6, no fill or very faint gradient fill, no gridlines
chart_card.tooltip: small white pill with shadow + 8px dot on the line + vertical dashed guide
chart_card.delta_badge: caption with arrow icon, red for negative / green for positive

payment_receipt_card.status_row: label left, success text + check icon right (green)
payment_receipt_card.detail_rows: label (body) left, value right; separated by hairline

promo_banner.content: oversized display text + 3D character cropped at edge

components.stacked_cards_carousel: rotated (-8 to +8 deg) overlapping illustrated cards with pastel fills, radius 20, partially cut by screen edge

credit_style_card.content: logo top-left, masked digits bottom-left, toggle/switch bottom-right, mascot top-right

components.avatar_row_with_amount: circle avatar 48px with status dot, name body_strong below, amount micro grey
components.notification_chip_row: tinted rounded cell (radius 16) with stacked avatars + 1 to 2 line text + caption

patterns: Sheets slide up with spring overshoot
Progress rings/bars animate fill on mount
Mascots/stickers idle bob (+-4px, 3s loop) or pop-in with scale 0.8 to 1

content_patterns.tone: warm, casual, encouraging, short sentences, occasional emoji or sparkle
content_patterns.support_text: 1 to 2 lines, grey, centered in modals
content_patterns.numbers: formatted with thousands separators and currency symbol; units attached (kcal, ml, steps, hrs)
content_patterns.dates: short format; urgent dates colored red

screen_archetypes.name: Progress / learning list
screen_archetypes.recipe: Gradient hero with progress pill -> icon grid (4x2 squircles) -> segmented control -> list rows with ring progress and one filled orange 'Start' button

screen_archetypes.name: Receipt / transaction detail
screen_archetypes.recipe: Sky gradient hero + centered avatar overlapping card top -> name -> two secondary pill buttons -> big gradient amount -> detail rows -> full-width gradient CTA

screen_archetypes.name: Wallet / asset dashboard
screen_archetypes.recipe: Giant display title -> rotated stacked illustrated cards -> 4 circular actions -> asset card with value + delta + smooth purple chart + tooltip -> grey full-width secondary button

screen_archetypes.name: Social invite / empty-state modal
screen_archetypes.recipe: White sheet with close button -> two big mascots -> centered display headline + grey subtext -> avatar row -> black pill CTA

screen_archetypes.name: Celebration / streak
screen_archetypes.recipe: Warm cream-to-white gradient -> mascot cluster with speech bubbles -> centered headline + subtext -> orange full-width CTA -> notification chip row below

screen_archetypes.name: Wellness daily check-in
screen_archetypes.recipe: Mint/cream gradient card -> day selector with moods -> info chip row with avatars -> 2-col stat tile grid

screen_archetypes.name: Finance subscriptions
screen_archetypes.recipe: Purple hero with giant lettering + 3D characters -> balance card with 4 shortcuts -> list of subscription rows (logo, name, next charge, price/cycle) -> purple promo banner

screen_archetypes.name: Card / transfers
screen_archetypes.recipe: Gradient bank-card visual -> row of 3 pill actions -> recent contacts avatar row with amounts -> category pills + list

screen_archetypes.name: Paywall / premium
screen_archetypes.recipe: Soft pastel hero with sticker art -> title + subtitle -> radio pricing cards -> 'what is included' feature rows with toggles

do: Use white cards (radius 24) on a #F0F0F7 canvas with soft purple-tinted shadows.
Make exactly one dominant CTA per screen: full-width pill, black or orange or sunset-gradient.
Use squircle (radius 16) tinted tiles for icons; pair each with a saturated pastel color.
Pair a bold, tight-tracked headline with small grey supporting text.
Use pastel gradient heroes and let illustrations/avatars overlap card edges.
Use inner cells (#F6F6FA, radius 16) for list rows and stat tiles inside white cards.
Right-align numeric values; keep subtitles tiny and grey.
Use round avatars with white rings and small status dots; stack them with negative margin.
dont: Do not use sharp corners, heavy borders, or dark/gritty palettes.
Do not use more than two saturated accent hues on one screen (excluding illustrations).
Do not use dense tables or small tap targets (<44px).
Do not use hard drop shadows or pure-black shadows.
Do not use thin/light font weights for headlines.
Do not copy the literal text, names, brands, or numbers from reference screenshots; use placeholder content suited to the feature being built.
accessibility: Maintain 4.5:1 text contrast; do not place grey text on saturated gradients (use white or black).
Do not rely on color alone for status; pair with icon or label.
Support dynamic type: use rem/sp units and allow wrapping.
build_order: 2. Build primitives: Card, InnerCell, Button, Pill, Avatar, IconTile, Toggle, Progress.
3. Compose patterns: ListRow, StatTile, SegmentedControl, DaySelector, BalanceCard, PricingOption.
4. Assemble screen archetypes with a gradient hero + stacked cards + a single CTA.
5. Add placeholder illustration slots (aspect-ratio boxes with gradient fills) where hero art/mascots go.
ai_implementation_guidelines.illustration_placeholder_guidance: When no asset exists, render a pastel gradient blob or emoji/avatar circle in the hero slot, plus 2 to 3 sparkle shapes, instead of leaving it empty.

prompt_template_for_cursor: Build [SCREEN/FEATURE] following the attached design system JSON. Use the tokens exactly, a pale lavender-grey canvas, white 24px-radius cards with soft shadows, bold tight-tracked headlines, tinted squircle icon tiles, inner cells (#F6F6FA, 16px radius) for rows, a pastel gradient hero with overlapping illustration/avatar slot, and ONE full-width pill CTA. Use placeholder content only. Make it responsive for a 390px-wide mobile viewport.
